content.raw:
Haematology covers the diagnosis and treatment of blood disorders, both malignant and non-malignant. At our partner hospital, haematologists work closely with immunology, genetics, haematopathology, infectious diseases, biochemistry and radiology, supported by a strong laboratory. MedLuxLife organises your appointments, prepares your medical files in advance and supports you and your family throughout treatment abroad.

Treatments and services

Laboratory-based diagnosis

Clinical experience combined with modern laboratory methods helps to reach a reliable diagnosis without unnecessary delay.

Multidisciplinary collaboration

Cases are discussed with immunology, genetics, haematopathology, infectious diseases, biochemistry and radiology specialists.

Haematological cancer care

Treatment planning for leukaemias, lymphomas, plasma cell disorders and related conditions.

Non-malignant blood disorders

Assessment and management of anaemias, haemoglobinopathies and other benign blood conditions.

Chemotherapy by specialist nurses

Chemotherapy is given by experienced nurses who are attentive to the physical and emotional needs of patients with blood cancers.

Autologous stem cell transplantation

Transplantation using the patient's own stem cells, alongside conventional treatment where appropriate.

Allogeneic stem cell transplantation

Transplantation from a suitable sibling donor. Indications can include acute and chronic leukaemias, lymphomas, multiple myeloma, aplastic anaemia, myelodysplastic syndrome, thalassaemia and sickle cell anaemia.

Conditions treated

  • Acute and chronic leukaemias
  • Lymphomas
  • Plasma cell disorders
  • Multiple myeloma
  • Myeloproliferative diseases
  • Myelodysplastic syndromes
  • Aplastic anaemia
  • Haemolytic anaemias
  • Iron deficiency anaemia
  • Haemoglobinopathies
  • Thalassaemia
  • Sickle cell anaemia

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Recent full blood count and other blood test results
  • Bone marrow biopsy reports, if available

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Haematology consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Request a Free Consultation
WhatsApp

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.
